title: Mango Colada Chia Pudding

items: 140 grams epigamia / any “high protein” greek yogurt
1 tbsp honey, if the mango is not very sweet - I did not need to use any
2 tbsp granola per serve for crunch and flavour

method: Combine coconut milk, greek yogurt, mangoes and water in a mixer and blend well
Add in the chia seeds and combine
Leave in the fridge, covered, overnight
The next morning, layer the chia pudding, granola and chopped mangoes and its ready to enjoy
Perfect for meal prep or on the go!
